topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I got these flowers today, out of nowhere, no card or anything. They're beautiful, really, but I can't help thinking about who might have sent them and why they didn't want to say. Maybe it’s something I’m supposed to guess, or maybe it’s just a random act of kindness. I don’t know. Part of me hopes it’s from someone who noticed me, you know? But another part is just lost, trying to figure out the point. Flowers are supposed to mean something, right? So what does it mean when they come without words? I wish I knew.
